description: Production = the inverse of the comprehension stack (PROJECT vs LIFT): fix a deictic origin + voice, take an intended meaning (situation-model state / stance), realize events as clauses (inverse of semantic-role extraction, active/passive = role promotion), and apply a figure operator forward (displace L->F), with the voice histogram selecting which figure. Correct iff the round-trip reads back.

attrs.name: production
attrs.description: The PROJECT arm of the projection/LIFT duality and the inverse of the whole comprehension stack: reading is LIFT (surface -> view-independent situation model); production is forward projection — structure run through a chosen viewpoint until it lands as surface text. Every faculty run in reverse: reading RECOVERS which displacement was applied and undoes it; production CHOOSES a displacement and APPLIES it forward, from a literal core out to the displaced surface.

attrs.name: surface_realization
attrs.description: The inverse of semantic-role extraction: a role-tuple -> surface order + inserted function words. The deictic ORIGIN (person/tense/POV) is the viewpoint fixed before projecting; the active/passive choice is just which role is promoted to the topical front under that viewpoint (agent-front=active; theme-front + by-phrase=passive).

attrs.name: figurative_production
attrs.description: Apply a figure operator FORWARD — the inverse of figure-recovery: metaphor swaps in a cross-domain vehicle, simile leaves the +like/as bridge, hyperbole pushes a scalar up, understatement negates the opposite, irony asserts the context-opposed value. Each is a small displacement of a literal L into a figurative F.

attrs.name: voice_as_generator
attrs.description: Voice was defined as the OPERATOR that generates paths; in production it is RUN, not read. The voice figure-histogram is a generator: it weights which figure displacement fires (a dry voice weights understatement/irony, an exuberant one hyperbole/metaphor). The operator selects the displacement, the histogram weights it, the origin frames it, and the role-tuple supplies the literal payload it displaces — that is what makes voice a real generator.

attrs.name: production_is_inverse_lift
attrs.head: production
attrs.body: production is forward projection (PROJECT) where comprehension is LIFT; each step is a Term/Rule already held, pointed the other way — viewpoint node, voice operator, role-promotion rule, figure kernel composed forward

attrs.name: production_round_trip
attrs.head: production
attrs.body: production is correct iff it is the clean INVERSE of reading, measured by reading: read back the produced text with the comprehension stack and check LIFT recovers the intended situation-model state AND re-identifies the voice from its figure-histogram; a mismatch IS the gradient (over-displaced / lost a role / wrong voice) to re-aim and re-project
